fields.label: API address
fields.description: Address of the panel's API (the cmd/api server), for example https://api.example.com. Do not add /reseller/v1.

fields.label: Reseller API key
fields.description: The API key of the reseller account, from the panel's API key page. Only reseller accounts work.

fields.label: Panel address (optional)
fields.description: Where sub-resellers sign in to the panel. It is shown in the credentials sent to the customer. Leave empty to show none.

fields.label: E-mail the credentials to the customer
fields.description: Send the sign-in details to the customer's e-mail address as soon as a line or account is created.

fields.label: Installation id
fields.description: Set automatically. It is part of every request id so that two shops using the same reseller key never replay each other's orders. Do not change it.
